:root { --primary-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #064bc6 0%, #1199ec 100%); --primary-color: #064bc6; --secondary-color: #1199ec; --bg-color: #ffffff; --chat-bg: #f8fafc; --text-primary: #1e293b; --text-secondary: #64748b; --border-color: #e2e8f0; --message-bot-bg: #ffffff; --message-user-bg: var(--primary-gradient); --input-bg: #f8fafc; --shadow-lg: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 4px 6px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); --shadow-xl: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(6, 75, 198, 0.15), 0 10px 10px -5px rgba(6, 75, 198, 0.1); --radius-lg: 1rem; --radius-full: 9999px; }

.dark-mode { --bg-color: #1a1a2e; --chat-bg: #16213e; --text-primary: #e2e8f0; --text-secondary: #94a3b8; --border-color: #334155; --message-bot-bg: #1e293b; --input-bg: #1e293b; --shadow-xl: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), 0 10px 10px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3); }

* { margin: 0px; padding: 0px; box-sizing: border-box; }

body { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; background-color: transparent; }

.chat-float-wrapper { position: fixed; bottom: 24px; right: 24px; z-index: 999998; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; pointer-events: auto; }

.chat-float-button { width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 50%; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; cursor: pointer; background: var(--bg-color); box-shadow: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3) 0px 4px 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); position: relative; overflow: hidden; padding: 0px; }

.chat-float-button::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -2px; border-radius: 50%; padding: 2px; background: var(--primary-gradient); mask: linear-gradient(rgb(255, 255, 255) 0px, rgb(255, 255, 255) 0px) content-box exclude, linear-gradient(rgb(255, 255, 255) 0px, rgb(255, 255, 255) 0px); opacity: 0.8; }

.chat-float-button::after { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid var(--primary-color); animation: 2s cubic-bezier(0.215, 0.61, 0.355, 1) 0s infinite normal none running pulse-ring; opacity: 0; }

@keyframes pulse-ring { 
  0% { transform: scale(0.95); opacity: 0.5; }
  50% { opacity: 0.3; }
  100% { transform: scale(1.5); opacity: 0; }
}

.chat-float-button:hover { transform: scale(1.05) translateY(-2px); box-shadow: rgba(6, 75, 198, 0.4) 0px 8px 20px; }

.chat-float-button img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 50%; padding: 2px; background: rgb(240, 242, 245); }

.chat-float-button svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 50%; }

.chat-float-button.hidden { transform: scale(0) rotate(180deg); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }

.chat-widget { position: fixed; bottom: 100px; right: 24px; width: 380px; max-width: calc(-48px + 100vw); height: 600px; max-height: calc(-120px + 100vh); background: var(--bg-color); border-radius: 24px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl); display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; z-index: 999999; transform-origin: right bottom; transition: 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); pointer-events: auto; }

.chat-widget.minimized { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.9) translateY(20px); pointer-events: none; bottom: 24px; }

.chat-header { background: var(--primary-gradient); padding: 20px 24px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; color: white; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }

.chat-header::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0px; background: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='20' height='20' viewBox='0 0 20 20' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cg fill='%23ffffff' fill-opacity='0.05' fill-rule='evenodd'%3E%3Ccircle cx='3' cy='3' r='3'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='13' cy='13' r='3'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E"); opacity: 0.3; }

.chat-header-content { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; z-index: 1; }

.header-avatar { width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3); overflow: hidden; background: white; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }

.header-avatar img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 50%; background: rgb(240, 242, 245); }

.header-avatar svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 50%; }

.chat-title-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }

.chat-title { font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }

.chat-status { font-size: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; opacity: 0.9; }

.status-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; background: rgb(74, 222, 128); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.5) 0px 0px 8px; }

.header-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; z-index: 1; }

.header-btn { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; color: white; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; backdrop-filter: blur(4px); }

.header-btn:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25); }

.header-btn.refresh-btn { transition: 0.3s; }

.header-btn.refresh-btn:hover { transform: rotate(-45deg); }

.header-btn.close-btn:hover { transform: rotate(90deg); }

.header-btn svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

.chat-messages { flex: 1 1 0%; overflow-y: auto; padding: 24px; background: var(--chat-bg); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; scroll-behavior: smooth; }

.chat-messages::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 5px; }

.chat-messages::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgb(203, 213, 225); border-radius: 10px; }

.message { max-width: 85%; animation: 0.3s ease 0s 1 normal none running slideIn; position: relative; }

@keyframes slideIn { 
  0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
  100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0px); }
}

.message.user { align-self: flex-end; }

.message.bot { align-self: flex-start; }

.message-bubble { padding: 14px 18px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) 0px 1px 2px; position: relative; overflow-wrap: break-word; text-align: left; }

.message-bubble.rtl { direction: rtl; text-align: right; }

.message-bubble.ltr { direction: ltr; text-align: left; }

.message.user .message-bubble { background: var(--primary-gradient); color: white; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; }

.message.bot .message-bubble { background: var(--message-bot-bg); color: var(--text-primary); border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; }

.message.user .message-bubble.rtl { border-bottom-right-radius: 18px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; }

.message.user .message-bubble.ltr { border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 18px; }

.message.bot .message-bubble.rtl { border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 18px; }

.message.bot .message-bubble.ltr { border-bottom-right-radius: 18px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; }

.message.bot .avatar-icon { position: absolute; bottom: -6px; left: -12px; width: 24px; height: 24px; background: white; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgb(229, 231, 235); display: none; }

.message-bubble a { color: inherit; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; }

.message-time { font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-top: 6px; margin-left: 4px; opacity: 0.8; }

.message.user .message-time { text-align: right; margin-right: 4px; }

.quick-actions { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; margin-top: 14px; }

.quick-action-btn { background: var(--bg-color); border: 2px solid rgb(203, 213, 225); color: var(--text-primary); padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 22px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s; text-align: left; font-family: inherit; opacity: 0; animation: 0.3s ease 0s 1 normal forwards running fadeSlideIn; }

.quick-action-btn:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.05s; }

.quick-action-btn:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.1s; }

.quick-action-btn:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.15s; }

.quick-action-btn:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.2s; }

.quick-action-btn:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 0.25s; }

.quick-action-btn:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 0.3s; }

@keyframes fadeSlideIn { 
  0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); }
  100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0px); }
}

.quick-action-btn:hover { border-color: var(--primary-color); color: var(--primary-color); background: rgba(6, 75, 198, 0.04); transform: translateX(4px); }

.quick-action-btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

.dark-mode .quick-action-btn { background: var(--message-bot-bg); border-color: rgb(71, 85, 105); color: var(--text-primary); }

.dark-mode .quick-action-btn:hover { border-color: var(--secondary-color); color: var(--secondary-color); background: rgba(17, 153, 236, 0.1); }

.dark-mode .chat-messages::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgb(71, 85, 105); }

.dark-mode .message-bubble { box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 1px 3px; }

.dark-mode .dot { background: rgb(100, 116, 139); }

.dark-mode .powered-by { color: rgb(71, 85, 105); }

.dark-mode .error-toast { background: rgb(127, 29, 29); color: rgb(254, 202, 202); }

.dark-mode .form-indicator { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(30, 58, 95) 0%, rgb(30, 41, 59) 100%); border-color: rgb(51, 65, 85); }

.dark-mode .form-indicator-title { color: var(--secondary-color); }

.dark-mode .form-exit-btn { background: rgb(30, 41, 59); border-color: rgb(71, 85, 105); color: rgb(148, 163, 184); }

.dark-mode .form-exit-btn:hover { background: rgb(127, 29, 29); border-color: rgb(153, 27, 27); color: rgb(254, 202, 202); }

.typing-container { padding: 12px 16px; background: var(--message-bot-bg); border-radius: 18px 18px 18px 4px; width: fit-content; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) 0px 1px 2px; display: none; align-items: center; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 16px; }

.typing-container.active { display: flex; }

.dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; background: rgb(156, 163, 175); border-radius: 50%; animation: 1.4s ease-in-out 0s infinite normal none running bounce; }

.dot:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: -0.32s; }

.dot:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: -0.16s; }

@keyframes bounce { 
  0%, 80%, 100% { transform: scale(0); }
  40% { transform: scale(1); }
}

.input-area { padding: 16px; background: var(--bg-color); border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; position: relative; }

.input-wrapper { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--input-bg); padding: 4px 4px 4px 12px; border-radius: 28px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); transition: 0.2s; }

.input-wrapper:focus-within { border-color: var(--primary-color); background: var(--bg-color); box-shadow: rgba(6, 75, 198, 0.1) 0px 0px 0px 3px; }

.chat-input { flex: 1 1 0%; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; background: transparent; padding: 8px 0px; font-size: 14px; outline: none; color: var(--text-primary); font-family: inherit; }

.chat-input::placeholder { color: rgb(148, 163, 184); }

.send-btn { width: 36px; height: 36px; background: var(--primary-gradient); border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; border-radius: 50%; color: white; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: 0.2s; flex-shrink: 0; }

.send-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(1.05); box-shadow: rgba(6, 75, 198, 0.3) 0px 4px 12px; }

.powered-by { text-align: center; font-size: 9px; color: rgb(203, 213, 225); margin-top: -2px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.3px; }

.send-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; background: rgb(229, 231, 235); }

.send-icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: currentcolor; margin-left: 2px; }

.error-toast { position: absolute; bottom: 80px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(20px); background: rgb(254, 226, 226); color: rgb(153, 27, 27); padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: 0.3s; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) 0px 4px 6px; width: max-content; }

.error-toast.active { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0px); }

.form-indicator { display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 10px 16px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(240, 249, 255) 0%, rgb(224, 242, 254) 100%); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(186, 230, 253); gap: 12px; animation: 0.3s ease 0s 1 normal none running slideDown; }

@keyframes slideDown { 
  0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-10px); }
  100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0px); }
}

.form-indicator.active { display: flex; }

.form-indicator-content { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex: 1 1 0%; min-width: 0px; }

.form-indicator-icon { width: 32px; height: 32px; background: var(--primary-gradient); border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; animation: 2s ease-in-out 0s infinite normal none running pulse-form; }

@keyframes pulse-form { 
  0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
  50% { transform: scale(1.05); }
}

.form-indicator-icon svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: white; }

.form-indicator-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; min-width: 0px; }

.form-indicator-title { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--primary-color); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

.form-indicator-status { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-secondary); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }

.form-indicator-status .dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; background: rgb(34, 197, 94); border-radius: 50%; animation: 1.5s ease-in-out 0s infinite normal none running blink; }

@keyframes blink { 
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
  50% { opacity: 0.4; }
}

.form-exit-btn { background: white; border: 1px solid rgb(226, 232, 240); color: rgb(100, 116, 139); padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; white-space: nowrap; flex-shrink: 0; }

.form-exit-btn:hover { background: rgb(254, 226, 226); border-color: rgb(252, 165, 165); color: rgb(220, 38, 38); }

        // Detect if text is RTL (Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu, etc.)
        function detectTextDirection(text) {

            const cleanText = text.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '').replace(/[^\w\s]/g, '');
            
            // RTL Unicode ranges:

            // Hebrew: \u0590-\u05FF

            // Arabic Extended: \u08A0-\u08FF

        function formatMessage(text) {

                .replace(/(https?:\/\/[^\s]+)/g, '<a href="$1" target="_blank">$1</a>')
                .replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
            return formatted;

        function addMessage(text, sender = 'bot') {

            messageDiv.className = `message ${sender}`;
            
            const time = new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });

            // Detect text direction for this specific message
            const textDirection = detectTextDirection(text);
            
            messageDiv.innerHTML = `
                <div class="message-bubble ${textDirection}">${bubbleContent}</div>
                <div class="message-time">${time}</div>

            // Insert before typing indicator
            chatMessages.insertBefore(messageDiv, typingIndicator);
            
            if (sender === 'user') {

                // For bot messages, especially long ones, scroll to the start of the message

                    sessionStorage.setItem('chat_cooldown', cooldownUntil.toString());
                    startCooldownTimer();

                detectFormFlow(data);

                errorToast.style.color = '#991b1b';

                chatInput.disabled = false;
                chatInput.focus();
                scrollToBottom();
